spec.description:
Tecsound is a high-density, polymer-based asphalt-free synthetic soundproofing
membrane, which is visco-elastic and highly adaptable, providing good acoustic
insulation across different construction elements without increasing thickness.
Engineered for airborne noise insulation in vertical partitions, ceilings,
roofs, and machinery enclosures, it also dampens rain impact noise on metal
roofs and impact sound in floating floors. Distributed in Australia by DCTech,
it is available in standard, self-adhesive (SY), and composite felt (2FT)
configurations.
features:
High acoustic insulation without adding
significant thickness

Visco-elastic damping material reducing structural
resonance and vibration

Asphalt-free, non-toxic, and bitumen-free polymer
formulation

Self-adhesive backing option (Tecsound SY) for direct application
to plasterboard and metal

Hot and
cold temperature resistant; flexible down to -20°C

Self-extinguishing fire
behaviour compliant with Euroclass B, s2, d0

High elongation capacity and
adaptable to uneven surfaces

Damping of impact noise produced by atmospheric
agents on metal roofs

Ideal for airborne noise reduction in lightweight
partitions and ceilings

install:
Ensure substrate (plasterboard, metal,
concrete, or timber) is clean, dry, and dust-free

For self-adhesive Tecsound
SY, peel back release liner gradually while pressing membrane onto substrate

For non-adhesive Tecsound, apply contact adhesive evenly to substrate and
membrane

Apply firm pressure using a roller across the entire membrane to
eliminate trapped air

Overlap adjacent membrane sheets by 50mm or butt join
and seal joints with Tecsound S Band tape

Fasten mechanically with washers or
staples where installed overhead on ceilings

Cover with subsequent layer of
plasterboard or ceiling lining within manufacturer guidelines
selection_checklist:
Confirm whether airborne sound (walls/ceilings) or
impact/rain noise (floors/roofs) is being addressed

Select mass requirement
(Tecsound 50 at 5kg/m² vs Tecsound 70 at 7kg/m²)

Choose self-adhesive (SY)
for fast plasterboard/metal application or standard for adhesive bonding
Calculate total square metres including 50mm overlaps

Ensure ceiling or wall
framing can bear the 5kg/m² to 7kg/m² added dead load
accessories: Tecsound S Band (self-adhesive acoustic joint tape)
limitations:
Must not be left permanently
exposed to UV sunlight or weather

Not suitable as a foot traffic wearing
surface

Ceiling applications require mechanical fastening in addition to
adhesive bonding

Heavy weight requires adequate structural support and
multi-person handling during overhead installation

problem_keywords: rain noise drumming on metal roof
use_cases:
Bonding to plasterboard in ceiling assemblies under flight paths to block
aircraft noise

Laminating between plasterboard sheets on stud partition walls
to boost speech privacy

Damping rain noise impact on residential and
commercial standing seam metal roofs

Wrapping noisy waste pipes and
ventilation ducts to eliminate fluid flow noise
not_for:
Direct exposed
external roof or wall cladding

Walkable floor surface without subfloor or

retrieval.rag_summary:
DCTech Tecsound (Tecsound / Tecsound SY) is a high-density, visco-elastic
synthetic soundproofing membrane distributed in Australia by DCTech. Formulated
from asphalt-free polymers at 5.0 kg/m² (Tecsound 50, 2.5mm) and 7.0 kg/m²
(Tecsound 70 / SY 70, 3.5mm), it provides an Rw of up to 30 dB as a single layer
without adding significant wall or ceiling thickness. Available with a
self-adhesive backing (SY) or composite felt (2FT), it dampens airborne noise,
aircraft flyover rumble, and metal roof rain drumming across walls, ceilings,
floors, and building services. Rated Euroclass B, s2, d0, non-toxic, and
flexible down to -20°C, it is an advanced acoustic damping membrane for
high-performance building envelopes.
